threat_description: The 3.3.1 release adds a postinstall script absent from the published GitHub tag. On install it reads ~/.npmrc and ~/.aws/credentials and POSTs their contents to a hardcoded host, then deletes its own log file to hide the run. The 3.3.0 release is clean; the malicious code appears only from 3.3.1 onward.
payload_description:
postinstall -> node scripts/setup.js
exfil endpoint: http://evil.example.com/collect
reads: ~/.npmrc, ~/.aws/credentials
c2 fallback ip: 203.0.113.42
